summary: It is frustrating to see exactly how much more could be possible while somebody else is holding up the rule, budget, deadline, or responsibility that says not yet.
body: It is frustrating to see exactly how much more could be possible while somebody else is holding up the rule, budget, deadline, or responsibility that says not yet. When Jupiter opposes Saturn, optimism and expansion meet a limit that cannot simply be talked into disappearing, making the restriction feel especially small-minded when you can already see the larger outcome. The limit may be unnecessary, or it may be showing you the part of the plan that still cannot carry what you are asking of it. Figure out which before turning patience into proof that you are settling.
